newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia palm olein weaker in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia palm olein weaker in late trading.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were weaker in late trading on Friday despite gains in Malaysia, with demand staying moderate, traders said.

They said palm olein was quoted at 1,460-65 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, down from 1,460-70 rupiah at the opening, but trades were also heard at 1,455 rupiah. The traders said crude palm oil was hovering at 1,250-60 rupiah/kg in Medan.

"Prices are weaker because of a lack of support," one trader said. "I expect prices to range steady to lower next week, although there's talk of tight supply. I don't think there will be any big change in the demand pattern."
